design.quote: This study investigated fluid and sodium balance over 3 months in a randomized, placebo-controlled trial (NCT03128528).

population.value: Patients with New York Heart Association class II-III chronic heart failure and an ejection fraction ≤49%
population.quote: 74 patients with New York Heart Association class II-III CHF and an ejection fraction (EF) ≤49% were randomized (2:1)

sample_size.quote: Overall, 74 patients with New York Heart Association class II-III CHF and an ejection fraction (EF) ≤49% were randomized (2:1) to empagliflozin 10 mg (n = 48) or placebo (n = 26).

follow_up.quote: Patients (mean age 66.4 years; 84% male; EF 40%; baseline N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide 707.9 pg/ml) were followed up at 1 and 3 months.
